name: Imagined 1 GW solar compute hub — Gobi

names.zh: 想象中的 1 GW 戈壁光伏算力枢纽

label: Imagined — a fictional design built from public numbers
label_zh: 想象设计——依据公开数据构建的虚构方案
famous_for: Solar + storage compute hub (East-Data-West-Computing context): 1,002 MW IT, 546,048 GPUs, PUE 1.17 — designed by us, checked by the engine
story: An imagined 1 GW compute hub in the Gobi near Jiuquan, in the spirit of the East-Data-West-Computing plan: 4 halls, 79 pods of 96 GB200 NVL72 rack systems, dry coolers in a plateau climate with a 14 °C daily swing, and a 2 GW solar field with 4 GWh of batteries next door. The engine gives PUE 1.17 at a summer afternoon; the national backbone links it to Qingyang, Xi'an, Beijing and Shanghai.
notable: 79 pods × 96 GB200 NVL72 rack systems (120 kW each from the catalog) = 546,048 GPUs.
Per pod the engine sees 12,686.1 kW IT, 14,864.5 kW facility, PUE 1.17 and 28,199,753 tokens/s at the design afternoon.
24 CoolIT CHx750 CDUs per pod carry 70 % of the heat as liquid; Vertiv Liebert CW CRAHs take the rest.
A year at 0.32 CNY/kWh: ¥3291 M for 10,284,240 MWh; 823 kt CO₂ at 80 g/kWh.
Catalog list prices cover 5 of 8 part types per pod; the GB200 NVL72 has no list price in the catalog, so the BOM leaves it out.
assumptions: Scale: 1,000 MW IT target from the brief (IMAGINED-GIANTS.md §1); the pod count is that target ÷ the engine's pod IT load.
Rack system: catalog record rack_system/nvidia/gb200-nvl72, 120 kW IT, 72 GPUs, 70 % liquid-cooled (catalog thermal data).
Cooling: cdu/coolit/chx750 CDUs (750 kW, catalog) in loops of 3 per row, N+1; heat rejected to dry coolers; crah/vertiv/liebert-cw CRAHs (120 kW) on a chilled-water plant for the air share.

Power: 2N from a 400 kV substation through ATS (grid / genset bank), transformers, switchboards and MW-class UPS banks (generic nodes: no MW-class UPS in the catalog), busway taps per rack; standby genset banks of Cat 3516C (2 MW standby, catalog); 2 GW solar PV + 4 GWh battery storage (as a site summary; diesel standby in the hall model).
Climate: a July day at 22 °C mean with a 14 °C daily swing and 35 % RH (typical July climate for the region); the numbers are read at 15:00 local, the warmest hour.
Grid factor 80 g CO₂/kWh and tariff 0.32 CNY/kWh: dc-world/reports/giants-references.md §2 / §3.
Tokens: every rack serves a 70B chat model at 70–95 % load (engine estimate from GPU memory bandwidth and FLOPS; labelled estimated, not a benchmark).
Water: closed-loop dry coolers, no consumptive water (evaporative trim not modelled).
Estate: the DR and peer sites, link capacities and carriers are part of the imagined design, not real contracts; latency is estimated from distance.

References for scale, cooling and power patterns: §1.7 东数西算 hubs: Qingyang PUE < 1.15, 0.28–0.38 RMB/kWh, free-air plateau climate; §1.6 Zhangbei: free-air cooling up to 300 days/year; §2.4 Northwest grid 560–620 g/kWh; green PPA ~50–120 g/kWh (dc-world/reports/giants-references.md).

derived.basis: engine on the representative hall (hall.json) at 15:00 local, mid-July, scaled by the pod count; rounded

waterM3PerDay.note: closed-loop dry coolers: no consumptive water; evaporative trim on the hottest days is not modelled

zh.concept: 光伏 + 储能算力枢纽（东数西算背景）
zh.famous_for: 光伏 + 储能算力枢纽（东数西算背景）：IT 1,002 MW、546,048 块 GPU、PUE 1.17——由我们设计，经引擎校验
zh.story: 想象中的 1 GW 算力枢纽，位于酒泉附近的戈壁，呼应"东数西算"：4 个机房、79 个单元，每个单元 96 台 GB200 NVL72 整机柜；高原气候昼夜温差 14 °C，采用干冷器散热，旁边是 2 GW 光伏和 4 GWh 储能。引擎给出夏季午后 PUE 1.17；国家骨干网将它连到庆阳、西安、北京和上海。
zh.water: 闭式干冷器：不消耗水；最热天的蒸发辅助冷却未模拟
assumptions: 规模：IT 目标 1,000 MW（来自 IMAGINED-GIANTS.md §1）；单元数 = 该目标 ÷ 引擎算出的单元 IT 负载。
整机柜：目录记录 rack_system/nvidia/gb200-nvl72，IT 120 kW、72 块 GPU，70% 液冷（目录热参数）。
冷却：cdu/coolit/chx750 CDU（750 kW，目录），每列 3 台组成环路，N+1；热量排向干冷器；风冷部分由 crah/vertiv/liebert-cw 精密空调（120 kW，冷冻水）承担。
供电：400 kV 变电站 2N 接入，经 ATS（市电 / 柴发组）、变压器、配电柜和兆瓦级 UPS（通用节点：目录中没有兆瓦级 UPS），每台机柜由母线槽插接箱供电；备用电源为 Cat 3516C 柴发组（2 MW 备用，目录）；2 GW 光伏 + 4 GWh 储能（作为站点概要；机房模型中为柴油备用）。
气候：七月典型日，平均 22 °C、昼夜温差 14 °C、相对湿度 35%；数值取当地 15:00，即最热的时段。
电网排放因子 80 g CO₂/kWh，电价 0.32 CNY/kWh：dc-world/reports/giants-references.md §2 / §3。
Token：每台机柜以 70–95% 负载运行一个 70B 对话模型（引擎根据 GPU 显存带宽和算力估算，标注为估算，并非基准测试）。
用水：闭式干冷器，不消耗水（未模拟蒸发辅助冷却）。
网络：灾备与对等站点、链路容量和运营商都是想象设计的一部分，并非真实合同；时延按距离估算。

规模、冷却和供电方式的参考：§1.7 东数西算 hubs: Qingyang PUE < 1.15, 0.28–0.38 RMB/kWh, free-air plateau climate；§1.6 Zhangbei: free-air cooling up to 300 days/year；§2.4 Northwest grid 560–620 g/kWh; green PPA ~50–120 g/kWh（dc-world/reports/giants-references.md）。

what_ifs.verdict: 可平稳度过。 UPS 最低剩余后备 10 分钟。
findings: Substation (400 kV, imagined) 失电 （另 6 项）
UPS bank A 电池供电 · 剩余 10 分钟 （另 3 项）

what_ifs.name: CDU 环路在机柜分水器处泄漏（6 L/min）
what_ifs.verdict: 业务中断。 1 台设备断电或保护停机（72 张 GPU）；关阀前漏出 1.4 L；损失 254.4 M Token。
findings: Manifold R001 漏液 · 已漏出 0 L
Manifold R001 漏液后已关阀隔离

what_ifs.name: 骨干光缆中断（GBS-1 ↔ XIY-POP）
what_ifs.verdict: GBS-1 ↔ XIY-POP 中断且无保护——流量绕行 QY-HUB–XIY-POP、GBS-1–QY-HUB（17 ms，原 16.6 ms）

notable: 79 个单元 × 96 台 GB200 NVL72 整机柜（目录：每台 120 kW）= 546,048 块 GPU。
引擎在设计午后看到的单个单元：IT 12,686 kW、设施 14,865 kW、PUE 1.17、每秒 28,199,753 Token。
每个单元 24 台 CoolIT CHx750 CDU 以液冷带走 70% 的热量；其余由 Vertiv Liebert CW 精密空调承担。
按 0.32 CNY/kWh 计一年：10,284,240 MWh、¥3,291 M；按 80 g/kWh 计 822,739 吨 CO₂。
每个单元 8 类部件中有 5 类有目录价；GB200 NVL72 在目录中无报价，物料清单未计入。
